OUTPUT.description: Folder below which bundle writes evidence/ when --out is not given.

OSF_NOW.description: The creation time of a bundle as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Default: the system clock.

GITHUB_SERVER_URL.description: Set by GitHub Actions. With GITHUB_REPOSITORY, the repository of a bundle when --repository is not given.

GITHUB_REPOSITORY.description: Set by GitHub Actions, for example acme/web.

PROOF_FORGE_URL.description: Base URL of the forge API for attach. GitHub: the REST API, default https://api.github.com. Forgejo: the server, default the origin of the pull request URL; proof adds /api/v1.

PROOF_FORGE_TOKEN.description: Token that may comment on the pull request and set commit statuses, for example GITHUB_TOKEN. Never write the value into a file.

AWS_ENDPOINT_URL.description: Endpoint of the S3-compatible store for attach --store. Default: AWS S3 in AWS_REGION.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key of the store. Never write the value into a file.

PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH.description: Where Playwright keeps its browsers, for capture. Default: Playwright's cache folder below HOME. Install Chromium with npx playwright-core install chromium.
